title: Vendor Document Missing Items
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:vendor
| stats values(document_type) as documents, sum(eval(if(document_status="missing",1,0))) as missing_docs by vendor
| sort - missing_docs
description: Finds vendors whose contracts, certificates, menus, or other key documents are still missing.
value: Vendor paperwork gaps create last-minute risk that is easy to avoid with a clear backlog view.
implementation: Track vendor document status in `event:vendor`; count missing document items per vendor.
visualization: Table of vendors with missing document counts.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which vendors are still missing important paperwork before the event.
